content: मिथुन {%a.%} [मिथ्-उनन् किच्च <ls>Uṇ. 3. 55</ls>] Paired, forming a pair, or couple. .{@-नः@} <ab>Ved.</ab> A pair, couple. .{@-नम्@} .²1 A pair, couple; मिथुनं परिकल्पितं त्वया सहकारः फलिनी च नन्विमौ <ls>R. 8. 61</ls>; <ls>Me. 18</ls>; <ls>U. 2. 5</ls>. .²2 Twins. .²3 Union, junction. .²4 Sexual union, copulation, cohabitation .²5 The third sign of the zodiac, {%Gemini%}. .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A root compounded with a preposition.
